notes: f64 arithmetic in the spec's exact order; rustc never contracts a * b + c into an FMA (only an explicit mul_add would).
Each row is packed into a reused Vec<u8> and written to a 64 KiB BufWriter over the locked stdout handle.
Digits are checked explicitly because str::parse::<u32> also accepts a leading '+'.
Release profile: opt-level 3, fat LTO, 1 codegen unit; static musl binary on a scratch image.
